$comment: Approximate seconds each real-binary acceptance spec file takes in CI, used only to balance the Colab acceptance shards (typescript/scripts/colab-acceptance-shards.mjs).
A stale or missing weight costs balance, never coverage: every spec file always lands in exactly one shard (guarded by typescript/test/tooling/colab-acceptance-shards.test.ts).

Whole seconds rounded up from passed-test duration sums in green main run 39240809828 (2026-10-19, 355cafbbe06cf3dd1800bd1418b424d4b493f83e), both shards; 137 passed cases across 45 files, one skipped case excluded. Outcomes matched one-to-one to list-reporter file/location/title because the public outcomes omit file IDs.

This is one observed green run, not a stable estimate or a measured improvement. Earlier weights used green runs 38218284566 and 38222074650 (2026-10-12), with up to 1.6x per-file variance. Refit after coverage changes; defaultSeconds applies to new files. Shard 1 also runs a separate hosted-reader proof (105 seconds in the source run), outside these suite weights.
